issues.quote: operating cash flow reaching $84.9 billion in fiscal 2024 against $84.9 billion in fiscal 2023
issues.problem: Amazon's fiscal 2024 operating cash flow was about $115.9B, not $84.9B ($84.9B is the fiscal 2023 figure). The sentence also contradicts itself by calling identical figures an improvement.

data.summary: Most figures are correct (revenue, net income, assets, liabilities, cash), but the fiscal 2024 operating cash flow is misstated as $84.9B; the correct figure is about $115.9B.
